title: ProfileConfig
description: JSON Schema for profiles/*.toml — pack-profile install bundles.

scope.description: Install scope — all packs in the profile must allow this scope (lint-profiles.py scope-homogeneous invariant).

description.description: One-line description of the profile's intended use case.

packs.description: Ordered list of packs to install — deps-first ordered (dependencies before dependents).

pack.description: Pack name as it appears in the catalogue.
